fields.Back: Participation (iClicker) 8%; two quizzes 10% (5% each); three assignments 37% (10% + 12% + 15%); midterm 15%; final exam 30%.

fields.Front: What minimum must you achieve on the midterm plus final to pass CS3357A, and what happens otherwise?
fields.Back: A weighted average of at least 40% across midterm and final; otherwise the maximum overall mark is 45%.

fields.Front: When is the CS3357A midterm and what is its format?
fields.Back: Monday, October 19, 2026, in class (MC-110) during lecture time; 1 hour 40 minutes, closed book, multiple choice; no make-up.

fields.Front: Per the revised Fall 2026 schedule, when are Quiz 1 and Quiz 2?
fields.Back: Quiz 1: Thursday, October 1 (shifted from Sept 24); Quiz 2: Thursday, October 29 (shifted from Oct 22), because the Sept 14 and 17 lectures were cancelled.

fields.Front: Per the revised schedule, when is Assignment 1 released and due?
fields.Back: Released Thursday, October 1; due October 23 (A2 released Oct 23, due Nov 6; A3 released Nov 6, due Nov 27).
